hypothesis: Evaluation resume permits incompatible execution budgets to share a result population.
controlled_boundaries: agent/controller/robot rollout replaced by deterministic result records
controls: unchanged settings allow resume and preserve earlier records
changed maximum action steps rejected before scheduling and without changing retained plan/results/summary
implicit suite defaults equal their explicit effective setting
a legacy manifest without execution identity is not silently rebound
rejected resume remains resumable with original settings
an incomplete fix that records only raw max_steps is rejected
qualification_limits: no owner participation or saved effort
cost_rule: Record executed commands and subprocess durations; do not substitute them for complete engineering or owner time.
